messages:
Incident Bot: :rotating_light: Alert triggered at 14:12:48 UTC — elevated 5xx rate observed on /v1/generate (US-WEST). Pager fired to on-call. Thread created.
Aisha Malik: I'm taking incident lead. War room link: https://meet.redwood.ai/rooms/war-room-1822502468 — please join if you have context. Owner: Aisha Malik. Who confirmed pager delivery? @Miguel @Sanjay
Miguel Torres: pager received at 14:12:52 UTC. Jumping into gateway and envoy traces now. :mag_right:
Sanjay Patel: seeing a burst of upstream 502/503 from runtime instances in model-pool-west-1. Reproduced with long-sequence repro locally. Saving logs to /tmp/oom-spike.log
Claire Nguyen: pinging Support & CS. Preparing a concise status page blurb and customer note, will paste for review before posting.
Evan Brooks: from runbook — initial mitigations: 1) reduce max_input_tokens to 1024 on the route; 2) shift 20% traffic to fallback smaller model; 3) trigger scale-up of runtime nodes. Do we want to apply all three simultaneously or phased? I recommend phased to observe effect.
Aisha Malik: phase 1: apply max_input_tokens cap and enable KV caching. If error rate persists, phase 2: split traffic to smaller variant (20%). If still high, phase 3: add node. Miguel, Sanjay, implement phase 1 now.
Miguel Torres: applying route cap and enabling KV cache.
Miguel Torres: commands executed:
```
# set per-route token cap
redwoodctl routes set --route /v1/generate --key max_input_tokens --value 1024
# enable prefix KV cache for route
redwoodctl cache enable --route /v1/generate --type prefix --ttl 1800
```
Sanjay Patel: checking node logs — dmesg shows repeated "Out of memory: Killed process 5127 (modelserve)" around 14:11:13 UTC. Looks like memory pressure triggered OOM killer on older nodes when handling >8k token requests.
Miguel Torres: after caps and cache, error rate dropped from 7.9% to 3.4% within 90s. Still above SLO. Suggest temporarily shifting 20% traffic to quantized variant gpt-medium-quant.
Aisha Malik: go ahead with 20% shift. Evan, prepare autoscale in case quantized routing doesn't push it under 2%.
Evan Brooks: routing command to add weight to quantized variant now.
Evan Brooks: command:
```
redwood route adjust --service text-gen --variant gpt-medium-quant --weight 0.2
```
Claire Nguyen: status page draft below. Please review — want to post once Aisha gives the go.
```
Status: Investigating elevated 5xx/502 errors impacting text-generation endpoints in US-WEST. Users may see intermittent 500/502 responses. Mitigations in progress: per-request token caps, KV cache enabled, portion of traffic routed to a lower-memory quantized model. Next update in 15 minutes.
```
Aisha Malik: edit: add "Potential degraded latency for some retries" and include support contact. Approve after edit.
Miguel Torres: quantized route applied. Error rate now at 1.2% — within acceptable threshold but still watching. Note: one older node still logged an OOM at 14:15:41 UTC and restarted its container; new nodes not affected so far.
Sanjay Patel: creating follow-up ticket for model memory profiling and to evaluate permanent rollout to quantized model for heavy long-sequence traffic. Will include replication steps and histogram of sequence length.
Claire Nguyen: customer notification draft:
```
Subject: Brief service degradation affecting text-generation API
Body: Hi — we experienced an increase in 5xx responses for text-generation requests in US-WEST. We have implemented temporary mitigations (per-request caps, routing to a quantized model, and cache adjustments) and are monitoring closely. If you see persistent errors, please reply with request IDs and region. Support: support@redwood.ai. Status page: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/INC-2026-078. Next update: in 15 minutes.
```
Aisha Malik: looks good — Claire, post the status and send the customer note. Include link to war room for internal responders only.
Incident Bot: Status page updated: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/INC-2026-078
Miguel Torres: autoscale not necessary at this time — but I spun a replace job to cycle the oldest node safely to clear any leaked memory. Command run:
```
redwood infra replace --pool model-pool-west-1 --target oldest
```
Evan Brooks: confirmed handover plan: Aisha will stay until 14:55 UTC, then hand to me for a 2-hour watch if metrics remain stable. Handoff criteria: error rate <2% for 10 consecutive minutes, no OOMs in node logs, and status page updated with latest ETA.
Aisha Malik: monitoring window started at 14:22:00 UTC. If green at 14:55, I'll transfer ownership to Evan. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
PagerDuty Bot: Handoff scheduled with owner set to Evan Brooks at 14:55 UTC. Incident PD link: https://pd.redwood.ai/incidents/1822502468
Miguel Torres: no new OOM messages since 14:18:06 UTC. Error rate steady ~1.0%.
Sanjay Patel: I'll kick off an RFC for quantized variant permanent adoption for long-sequence traffic and include evals and perf tradeoffs.
Claire Nguyen: posted customer notification and pinged account teams. Also updated the incident ticket with a short timeline and links to logs and runbook snippets.
Aisha Malik: handing to Evan at 14:55 UTC pending no regressions. If anything changes, re-open this thread. Thanks everyone."
